sections.content:
Timer is at 1. One more action and it'll probably be game over. Let me make a final attempt.
Wait — let me rethink the whole game one more time. Maybe I've been misunderstanding the board. Let me look at the image again:
- Top: a green/yellow bar (timer) on row 0, and a charcoal block at columns 36-39.
- Below the charcoal: a magenta 4×4.
- A blue gradient bar (the "player").
- Bottom: two yellow cups.
What if the magenta is a "drop" that falls when the blue bar is directly below it at the ceiling and I press SPACE... I did that. Nothing happened.
What if the blue bar needs to be at the floor, and the magenta falls and passes through the blue (the blue is a "net" that catches it), and then... no, that's not it.
What if the goal is to align the blue bar so that the magenta's column falls within the gap between the two cups (columns 28-39), and the magenta falls between the cups? The magenta is at columns 36-39, which is already between the cups (left cup ends at 27, right cup starts at 40). So if the magenta falls, it falls between the cups, not into either one.
Hmm, what if the blue bar is a "baffle" that redirects the falling magenta into a cup? The magenta falls from the top at columns 36-39. If the blue bar is at rows 12-15, columns 32-51 (covering 36-39), the magenta lands on top of the blue at rows 8-11. Then... it stays there. If the blue bar is at rows 12-15, columns 36-55 (left edge exactly at 36), the magenta (columns 36-39) lands on the leftmost part of the blue. If the blue is a "seesaw" tilted by the gradient... the magenta slides off the edge? The gradient is bright (left) → dark (right). If dark = high, then the blue tilts up to the right, and the magenta slides left, off the left edge at column 36, and falls to the floor between the cups. If bright = high, it tilts up to the left, and the magenta slides right... off the right edge at column 55? Falls to the floor at columns 52-55, to the right of the right cup.
None of this is verifiable — the magenta never falls.
The real question is: what triggers the magenta to fall? I've tried: SPACE (multiple positions), MOUSE on the magenta, MOUSE on the charcoal, MOUSE on the blue. Nothing.
What I haven't tried: MOUSE on the cup, MOUSE on the timer bar, MOUSE on the background, holding down an arrow key (multiple consecutive moves), the blue reaching the extreme positions (columns 0-19, columns 44-63, rows... the ceiling is 12, the floor is 44 — both tested).
Timer=1. One action left. The most informative final probe: MOUSE on the left cup (55,21). If clicking the cup does something (like "pour" or "activate"), I'll learn that. Otherwise, game over.
Actually — wait. One more idea. What if the win condition is that the blue bar is at the floor, with its left edge aligned to the left cup's opening (columns 20-23), i.e., blue at columns 20-39, rows 44-47, and then the timer... no, that's not it.
Or, what if the win condition is that the blue bar covers both cup openings... impossible (width 20, span 28).
Or, what if the win condition is that the blue bar is at the ceiling, columns 36-55 (current position!), and the timer reaches 0? That is, "survive" — no, the timer reaching 0 is game over.
Hmm, actually, wait. What if the timer reaching 0 isn't game over but is the trigger? The timer is currently at 1. After the next action it'll be at... -1 → 0. Maybe at 0 the magenta falls! If the magenta falls at timer 0 and the blue is at the ceiling columns 36-55 (directly below the magenta), the magenta lands on the blue, and... that might be the win condition: "catch the drop"!
That's a plausible game design: the drop falls at the end of the timer, and you have to position the platform below it. The blue is currently at rows 12-15, columns 36-55 — directly below the magenta (columns 36-39) ✓.
So the final action should keep the blue below the magenta. Any action will do — even another MOUSE, or even SPACE. The magenta will fall at timer 0. If it lands on the blue → win.
The blue is currently at columns 36-55, covering the magenta's columns 36-39 ✓. Let me execute a neutral action: SPACE (inert, just decrements the timer). If the game ends with a win, great.

    out={}
